set.body:
Source: PRD.html section 12 and requirements F-10, F-11, F-16, Q-03, and Q-05.

Scope:
- Define ControlStore[F] and an append-only committed event journal with versioned rows/messages.
- Persist canonical intent and request digest before scheduler action.
- Implement transactional outbox/reconciler, SubmissionKey idempotency, AcceptanceUnknown, binding history, attempt epochs, and result fencing.
- Implement current/stale/unavailable observations, resumable event cursors, agent/client restart recovery, and explicit asynchronous cancellation reconciliation.
- Add one coalesced, rate-limited, jittered observer per site; move terminal candidates from squeue to sacct and use focused scontrol only when needed.

Acceptance:
- Crash-edge tests cover every persisted transition before, during, and after sbatch.
- Lost acceptance responses never cause blind automatic resubmission.
- Same key plus same digest is idempotent; changed digest conflicts before scheduler action.
- Client and agent restart recover nonterminal attempts and committed event cursors.
- Slow consumers cannot block reconciliation or durable append.
set.title: P3: Implement durable managed submission and reconciliation
